plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a session handoff file and print where it is; with automatic updates turned on, keep it current at milestones.

plugins.name: debate
plugins.description: Run a subagent debate or multi-reviewer challenge when asked in words or with /debate:debate, at a preset (low, medium, high, max; medium by default) with adjustable settings; every role's model is set explicitly, the brief is sourced, a judge verifies, and time and usage are measured
